reviewer: OMP agent (M16 agent-native factory and migration)
note: FACTORY-003 preserve agent secrets: src/factory/strict_environment.zig gives a strict build an allow-list rather than a filtered host environment, because filtering hands over everything not recognised as a credential and the next credential does not exist yet - a build gets exactly what its declaration names, so an unknown variable is absent by construction. A declaration that asks for a credential is refused rather than trimmed, in both the allow-list and the values it sets. Nothing is redacted: a redacted value is still a value, so credentials are removed and a name that was in the host's environment simply does not exist for the build. The guarantee is checked twice, because two different claims are involved: the environment map is what this code believes, and a process spawned with it is what the operating system hands over - the test spawns a real child (cmd /c set on Windows, env on Linux) and asserts no credential name reached it while the allowed names did, so a child with an empty environment cannot pass by having nothing. Two process findings: my first registration of this module silently did nothing because the anchor I replaced did not exist, which made the characterization stage a vacuous pass on an unregistered test - caught, re-taken, and the registration now verifies itself; and the host regression then caught a real platform bug in an earlier module, because fromMode is POSIX-only and the portable form is the guarded one the repository already uses. Fault proof: recognising nothing as a credential lets a declaration ask for one and the refusal assertions fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
